Hi Aaron - the step now runs on your warehouse's default size. Setting a dedicated warehouse on the connection brought similar queries back to seconds for other customers.
A dedicated XS warehouse fixed it.
Thanks, closing.
Could you resend our latest invoice to accounts payable? Our copy went missing.
Hi Aaron - I've resent it to the billing contact on file. You can also download invoices from Admin > Billing.
Received, thank you.
Closing.
Our HTTP request step calls an internal report service that takes about 45 seconds, and the step times out.
Hi Wen - the default timeout is 30 seconds and can be raised to 120 in the step's advanced settings. For longer jobs, use the async pattern with a callback.
Raising it to 90 seconds is enough for us.
Closing this one.

subject: How long are run logs kept?

comments.body: Our auditors want to know how long flow run logs are retained.
Hi Nell - run history is kept for 400 days on Enterprise and 90 days on Business. You can export it to S3 for longer retention.
Thanks, that answers it.
Closing.
Our Slack notification step fails with 'channel_not_found' after we renamed a channel.
Hi Martin - the step stores the channel ID, but private channels need the Halden app to be invited. Invite the app to the channel and reselect it in the step.
Invited the app, messages post again.
Closing, thanks.
The Google Sheets connection used by our lead enrichment flow asks us to reconnect every few days.
Hi Ravi - this happens when the Google account that authorized the connection changes its password or loses access to the sheet. Reconnecting with a service account avoids it.
We moved it to a service account, stable since.
Great - closing.

subject: Password reset for a non-SSO user

comments.body: Our integration service user isn't behind SSO and needs a password reset.
Hi Derek - I've sent a reset link to the service user's email. Consider an API token instead of a password for integrations.
Reset done, and we'll switch to a token.
Closing.
The 'Parse spreadsheet' step fails on the Excel files our supplier emails us.
Hi Martin - the files are password-protected .xlsx. The step can't open protected files; ask the supplier to send them unprotected or as CSV.
Supplier now sends CSV.
Closing.
The HubSpot sync in our carrier booking flow creates duplicate contacts when emails differ in case.
Hi Aaron - set the match key to 'email (case-insensitive)' in the HubSpot upsert step. Existing duplicates can be merged in HubSpot.
Switched the match key, no new duplicates.
Closing this one.
Someone changed the weekly KPI export flow last week and it broke. Can we see who?
Hi Kim - open the flow and use Versions: each version shows the editor and a diff, and you can restore a previous version.
Found it and restored the previous version.
Glad to help - closing.
Our nightly job lists flow runs through the API and fails with 'cursor expired' after about 75 pages.
Hi Wen - cursors expire after 10 minutes. If the job pauses between pages, request smaller pages or restart from the last run ID with the 'after' filter.
We reduced the pause between pages and it completes now.
Closing, thanks.

subject: HMAC check fails on Halden webhooks

comments.body: Our endpoint rejects Halden webhooks because the HMAC signature doesn't match.
Hi Ravi - the signature is computed over the raw request body. Frameworks that parse and re-serialize JSON first will produce a different digest. Verify against the raw bytes.
That was it - our middleware parsed the body first.
Closing this out.
How do we pull the first line item's SKU out of an order payload?
Hi Rohan - use $.order.line_items[0].sku in the 'Extract value' step. The expression tester in the step shows the result against a sample payload.
Works, thanks!
Closing.
Emails sent by the notification step go to our users' junk folders.
Hi Aaron - adding Halden's sending domain to your SPF record and allow-listing notifications@halden.example usually fixes this. Instructions attached.
Our mail team allow-listed it; emails arrive now.
Great, closing.
